query.contract: vendor-directory.v1 opts into these fields; absent selector preserves the existing v1 row and facet shapes
query.territory: vendors only; exact bounded value; territories facet
query.paging: stable name/id ties, 25 rows per transport page

relationship.deals_referred: distinct sourced deal IDs, null until verified
relationship.deals_worked: distinct sourced worked deal IDs, null until verified
relationship.win_rate: worked won / (worked won + worked lost); null without verified coverage or resolved deals
relationship.last_contacted_at: latest linked mail, meeting, call or text timestamp, null if unknown
relationship.recent_entries: 20 linked activity entries, summary with original recorded detail
relationship.introductions: live exact party links: intro/intro_received/introduced (made), can_introduce/intro_requested (suggested)
relationship.override: tier/reason plus server-derived recorded_by/recorded_at; null clears override

trust.recency: days since latest linked contact; missing contact is Infinity; future contact cannot qualify a higher tier

write.trust_override: only verified human Joe/Dell; tier Proven/Established/Trial and nonblank reason <=500; authority/time are never client supplied
write.loan_programs: array of recorded program names or null
write.deal_evidence: complete replacement array <=100; exact live deal_id, referred/worked role, occurred_at, evidence_kind mail/calendar/salesforce/entry, nonblank evidence_ref; duplicate deal/role refuses
write.verify_deal_history: only verified human Joe/Dell may set true; server stamps time; any evidence replacement without verification invalidates coverage
write.audit: existing version guard, transaction, idempotency envelope and field-level event history
